milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the iron trapdoor (placed at spawn-relative [6, 0, 4] inside a stone brick structure) and face toward it. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually approached the structure (the trapdoor is ~7.2 blocks from spawn, so the player must move at least ~2 blocks toward it). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the trapdoor.
